scope: Real source Electron main/preload/renderer and durable input; scripted cognition only; not installed or real-model timing
checks: 200 real bot rows; no idle model turns
five input-to-visible searches across the real message corpus under budget
five real UI sends, visible durable Received under budget, scripted replies
real Quick Chat window lists bots and submits one canonical quick_chat input
scrolling up loads older messages from a 10000-message conversation
a quoted older message loads across pages, enters viewport, then returns to latest
profile opens and settings tab works
bot shell returns with all persisted identities
replyInteraction: quote is a context button with SVG; delivery policy is explicitly readonly
real dark/light context and action surfaces retain borders, readable hierarchy and no outer glow
process action has hover and visible keyboard focus; Enter opens the existing process drawer
memory disclosure retrieves the canonical memory and collapses without a nested status pill
selected quote uses the same context treatment, fits a 760px viewport and cancels by keyboard without losing the draft
streamingInteraction: receipt below user body; anchored waiting state and SVG stop control
real delta visible while controlled provider remains pending, before canonical reply
switching bots hides the other stream and restores the active snapshot
root post_reply text streams via shared parser; tools use compact SVG; no reasoning, arguments or results leak; history holds
completion replaces preview once, preserves Markdown and follows latest
stop preserves incomplete text, exact-turn process and draft; explicit retry creates one new reply
failure retracts unaccepted preview and offers explicit retry without duplicate replies
chatDetails: exact current-turn process uses localized operations; raw JSON is collapsed and keyboard accessible
freeform reply durably binds to its question and removes only those choices
failed freeform send retains choices; retry retains exact answer association and creates one canonical input
option click follows the same durable answer path; switching back does not restore answered choices
accessibility: focusable list: Home/End, arrows, Enter open the selected bot
Space opens the selected bot without scrolling the page
bot model is first: configured choices save and survive reopen; fixed switch and inherit preserve other roles, bots and global routing
settings groups, keyboard disclosures, visible switches, policy/local-model/global-concurrency persistence and sticky tabs
docked drawer enters selected tab, roves with arrows/endpoints, closes with focus returned; hidden dock is inert
900px emulated viewport modal drawer constrains Tab in both directions, Escape returns focus
oversize input is rejected before submission and the editable draft is retained
10000 memory records render 50 at a time; next and previous retain distinct identities
reduced motion stops avatar/enter displacement animations while drawer remains usable
actual list name/preview/time contrast reaches 4.5:1 in both light/dark and Frost/Catppuccin
custom quiet switch and HH:mm field use keyboard, save canonical values and expose independent labels
English settings/drawer/Quick Chat labels refresh from persisted locale; bot picker is custom
limitations: 源码隔离 Electron；不是签名安装包评测
